signature.name: Hongya Cave
signature.detail: A multi-storey stilt-house complex glowing with lights at night, it is Chongqing's most photographed sight and a must-see for its dramatic setting above the Jialing River. Go after dark for the full effect, and arrive before 7pm to avoid the worst crowds.

signature.name: Ciqikou Ancient Town
signature.detail: A preserved old town of cobbled lanes, teahouses and snack stalls, perfect for sampling local flavours and picking up crafts. Visit on a weekday morning for a quieter experience; it is easily reached by metro Line 1 to Ciqikou station.

signature.name: Dazu Rock Carvings
signature.detail: A UNESCO World Heritage site of Buddhist cliff carvings dating back centuries, offering a peaceful and awe-inspiring day trip from the city. Wear comfortable shoes for walking between the carvings, and allow at least half a day; buses run from Chongqing's main bus stations.

signature.name: Liziba Station
signature.detail: A metro station where trains pass directly through a residential building, a quirky symbol of Chongqing's mountainous terrain. Ride Line 2 to Liziba and watch from the viewing platform below; it is free and quick to visit.
